name: Stationary soles use support-local anchors, not a sine-wave gait
Level-ground jog keeps the stance ankle within 1 cm and skin palettes finite
Support-local stance anchors follow a translated platform
Visual posing leaves authoritative player and prop state unchanged
Both hand contact targets are reflected by actual distal finger bones
One hand releases without detaching the other
Crouch and an airborne transition keep all vertices transformable
Skin weights are normalized and every inverse bind reconstructs identity
